scope: All 88 snapshot adventure-layout records; 37 admitted true Adventure pairs and 38 other Adventures gated. All 13 distinct Omen pairs are now admitted by their independent Omen wrapper. Full source files are hashed. Admitted entries include direct imported semantic dependencies and the audited shared face/permission infrastructure; this does not claim every transitive Java dependency was rewritten.
